notes: RESEARCH LIMITS (read first): during this research WebFetch failed with a DNS error (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) for every host tried, including the brand sites, google.com and wikipedia.org, and the shared WebSearch budget ran out part-way. Every fact below was therefore read from search-engine extracts of the official pages and PDFs listed in sourceUrls, not from opening the pages directly. No image URLs could be collected, so every product has an empty images list. Before approving any price, a reviewer should open the linked official page or PDF and check it.

AGL: identified as AGL Bathware by Asian Granito India Ltd. (Ahmedabad, Gujarat). Evidence: the official site aglasiangranito.com has faucet, bathware, sanitary-ware and allied-products sections. Trade news reported a 2019 launch of 300+ faucet, shower and accessory SKUs and an entry into sanitaryware with 160 SKUs under the AGL brand (retail4growth.com; thetilesofindia.com). AGL publishes a faucet price list titled 'May 2026 PRICELIST' at https://aglasiangranito.com/catalogue/Faucet_Collection.pdf.

AGL products come from one code family in that price list: 291101CP, 291103CP, 291105CP, 291106CP, 291201CP, 291204CP and 291212CP, plus 132207CP. The PDF's text layer is garbled, so codes and prices often don't line up. Only one price could be read the same way twice (291101CP = 2290) and it is included; all other AGL prices are null. Other readings, NOT used: 291103CP 2420, 291201CP 9520, and black finishes 291101BL 2470, 291103BL 2475, 291105BL 3260, 291106BL 2005. The source names no series for the 291 family, so 'Code family' is our own label. The CP suffix is read as chrome-plated (the usual Indian faucet code convention), but AGL does not state this.

AGL items not included: the Cham series (aglasiangranito.com/cham, 23 items; codes 222101CP and 222103CP appear there) was left out because the item names and prices for its codes came only from retailers (Yoobuy, Navya Ceramics, Veda Ceramics, IndiaMART). The Tigris 611-series (gold and black finishes) and the 502-series (BL/BR/BG finishes) were left out because the finish codes are not explained in the source. Sanitaryware (EWC, wall-hung WC, wash basin) was left out because no official codes or prices could be read before the tools ran out. The price list mentions a 12-year warranty subject to the warranty card, but it was not confirmed for these items, so the warranty field is null.

Blues: identified as Blues Bath Fittings by Shah Multilayer Pvt. Ltd., Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Evidence: the official site bluesbathfittings.in (its About page names founder Sanjeev Gupta and Shah Multilayer, with a Noida address and bluesfaucets@gmail.com). Shah Multilayer's IndiaMART and TradeIndia profiles list Blues series (Momento, Spa and others), and a sourcinghardware.net channel-partner listing names the company and brand. The founding year conflicts: 1994 on the About page, 2007 on other listings. Distribution in Gujarat was not checked. An older domain, bluesbathfittings.com, appears in listings but did not resolve.

Blues products are from the Ace Collection (13 items, the everyday range), plus SQ-40 from the Square Collection. Prices are the figures shown on the Blues website's collection and product pages. The site does not label them MRP and does not say whether GST is included; we treat them as tax-inclusive (Indian retail convention), so mrp is null. Search metadata suggested some pages are old (1,000+ days), so prices may be stale. No AC-40 price could be read, and individual Ace product page URLs were not confirmed, so the collection page is used as the source. Blues pages give no material or finish details, so the variants are named 'Standard'.

Plumber: identified as Plumber Bathware by Aqua Plumbings Pvt. Ltd. Evidence: the official site plumberbathware.com ('Bathroom Fitting Manufacturers and Suppliers in Mathura, Delhi NCR') and its company presentation PDF titled 'AQUA PLUMBINGS PVT. LTD.'. Its lifetime-warranty page names Aqua Plumbings Private Limited (APPL). The manufacturing unit is at Gaur Udyog Kendra, Delhi–Mathura Bypass, Mathura 281001 (UP), and the corporate office is in Sector 65, Gurgaon. Spengler is a sister brand. This is not the generic word 'plumber'.

Plumber prices: the newest official faucet price list found is 'Plumber Faucets Price List' w.e.f. 2 April 2022 (plumberbathware.com/prices/Plumber-Faucets-Price-List-02.04.2022.pdf), with MRP and HSN 84818020 for cocks. No 2023–2026 list was found, so these MRPs are probably out of date. MRPs on the website's product pages match the older April 2021 list (e.g. EC-5111 shows 5835 on the site against 6805 in the 2022 list), so the 2022 list is used where it covers the item. Items found only on product pages (EC-0209, U-0507, UBP-0450) use the product-page MRP and are marked as probably outdated.

Plumber warranty: plumberbathware.com/life-time-warranty describes a 'Lifetime Performance Warranty'. It covers residential use, needs a certificate generated within 30 days of purchase (otherwise the standard 10-year warranty applies) and is 5 years for commercial use. It was not confirmed that Economy and Universal items carry the lifetime certificate, so the warranty field is null.

Aris: NOT identified with confidence, so no products are included. No official website or manufacturer could be found. Results showed only unrelated traders using the name in Gujarat and elsewhere (IndiaMART/TradeIndia: Raj Tiles Vadodara, Home Sanitary Ahmedabad, Supro Sanitary Wares Morbi, Ajit Trading Mehsana, an 'Aris Bath Fittings' retailer in Rajkot, Zorba Constro Pune, D K Bath Shoppy Hyderabad). Their warranty claims (5, 7 and 10 years) and model codes (PAC-2501, WP210, NJ-020, 912, Mini Florentine) don't match each other. Similar names belong to other things: ARK Bath Fittings (Panchkula), 'Aris' as a product name at Artize, Prestige and Caisson, and an 'Aries' series in AGL's own faucet price list. The shop should check the manufacturer name and address printed on an Aris box or invoice.

Bottle traps were found (Plumber UN-1730 Bottle Trap 32mm, MRP 1395 on its product page; Plumber Bottle Trap 'Slim', MRP 1630; Blues BT-01 Bottle Trap Primex SS pipe 5"x12", no price). They were left out because the body material, and so the HSN code, is not stated. Plumber's price list lists health faucets (Ultima, Curvy, Bellezza, Italian Square) and an overhead shower (ITP-2031, 1975 in the 2022 list), but their details could not be confirmed, so they are not included.

HSN: 84818020 is taken from Plumber's own price list for its cocks. Other taps and mixers use 8481, and the PVC connection hose uses 3917 (plastic tubes and hoses). The 18% GST rate is believed correct, but the shop's accountant must confirm all HSN codes and GST rates.
